not_met.question: Q2
not_met.lacks: A developer building a plugin whose skill does its work itself, with no roles, can't tell what that skill's part holds. The best practice allows such a plugin at plugin/best-practice.md:110: "Where a plugin has roles, its skill makes the main conversation the orchestrator." plugin/template/README.md:33 leaves out the agents, the proposal, and hooks/hooks.json for a plugin with no roles, but keeps the skill and its part. That part keeps as fixed text, at plugin/template/domain/command.md:3 to :6 and :17, that the main conversation starts each role it's told to start and makes nothing of the work, and at plugin/template/domain/command.md:57 it ends the run once Lane says to start no more. Filling the template, such a developer gets a part that has the main conversation start roles and wait on routes that don't exist, and no form for the work that the skill does itself.

not_met.question: Q3
not_met.lacks: A plugin whose users need a page beyond the README to use it finds no section for that page. Lane's users, for one, write their rules from docs/lanes.md and docs/routes.md, which plugins/lane/README.md:281 offers "for you as you write rules." The template and its order, at plugin/template/README.md:8 to :35, hold no such page, and the readme kind leaves each later need to "its own kind of page," at readme/best-practice.md:141. Such a plugin made with every section of the template still leaves its users without what they need to use it.
